purpose: Auditable source-level policy evidence for catalog discovery and safe ingestion. These reviews are not legal advice and do not grant record-level rights clearance.

policy.rule: A source-level policy review never clears every page or asset on a host. Require record-level provenance, content-origin classification, applicable license/terms, privacy review, and attribution before publication.

findings: NIST states that site information is public and may be distributed or copied except material marked copyrighted; appropriate byline/photo/image credits are requested.
NIST employee-created data and works outside the Standard Reference Data Act are generally not protected by U.S. copyright, but foreign copyright may apply.
NIST Standard Reference Data may be protected under 15 U.S.C. § 290e and must follow the specific SRD license terms.
Contractor, extramural, and other third-party material may carry separate rights or conditions; technical publications may include third-party works.
mandatory_checks: Classify each candidate as NIST employee-created non-SRD, SRD, contractor/extramural, third-party, or unknown.
Do not redistribute SRD or third-party content without its applicable license or permission.
Preserve NIST attribution and recommended dataset/software citation details.
Keep unknown-origin content metadata-only and non-commercial.
reviews.api_access: No API access approval inferred from this page-level review.

findings: NPS says material it created and presents is generally public domain unless otherwise indicated.
NPS warns that third-party copyright, trademark, privacy, publicity, donor restrictions, and contractual restrictions may apply.
NPS marks, including the Arrowhead insignia, are protected trademarks and may not be used without prior written permission.
For commercial publication or republication of NPS-created material, the copyright notice must state that no protection is claimed in the original U.S. Government work.

api_access.rate_limit_scope: per API key across developer.nps.gov API requests
api_access.rule: Do not call the NPS API until a valid project-owned key is available; obey response rate-limit headers and the rolling hourly quota.

mandatory_checks: Distinguish NPS-created records from third-party or donor-supplied material.
Do not republish third-party photos, films, music, graphics, or other assets without record-level permission.
Do not use NPS trademarks or insignia without permission.
Preserve attribution and the required government-work notice for commercial republication of eligible NPS-created material.

findings: The Census API terms permit building services to search, display, analyze, retrieve, view, and otherwise obtain Census Bureau data.
Applications using the API must display the Census Bureau's non-endorsement attribution notice.
API data must not be modified or falsely represented as Census content.
Census data must not be combined or used to identify individual people, households, businesses, or other respondents; do not publish combinations that identify respondents.
The Census Bureau may limit or terminate API access for policy or usage violations.

api_access.rate_limit_policy: Follow current API guidance and response behavior; do not rely on older no-key daily limits.

reviews.required_attribution: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
mandatory_checks: Do not call the Census API until a valid project-owned free key is available.
Display the required non-endorsement notice wherever API data is presented.
Do not combine Census data with other datasets in a way that identifies respondents.
Preserve dataset title, vintage, API base URL, and access date for citation.
Do not infer a blanket license for non-API Census website articles, images, or third-party materials.

reviews.content_reuse: conditional_by_dataset; current portal Terms of Use not located
findings: The City of Las Vegas Open Data Guide states that city-published datasets are placed in the public domain without use or reuse restrictions.
The same guide states that portal content is subject to separate Information Technology terms of use posted on the portal; those current portal terms were not located in this review.
The City guide requires review for protected and sensitive information and specifically warns about personally identifying information and mosaic-effect risks.
The official portal exposes an OGC API Records search interface with catalog, collection, and item endpoints; endpoint availability does not itself authorize automated harvesting or republication.
mandatory_checks: Locate and verify the current portal Terms of Use before any automated API harvesting.
Verify robots.txt, API request limits, and any portal-specific access rules before making requests.
Review every dataset separately for its public-domain status, provenance, attribution, freshness, and any third-party or contractor content.
Exclude protected, sensitive, and personally identifying fields; assess mosaic-effect risks before combining datasets.
Keep all records metadata-only and non-commercial until dataset-level terms, privacy, and provenance checks are complete.
Do not download or republish feature data, attachments, imagery, or other media under this source-level review.
reviews.api_access: Not authorized yet: current portal Terms of Use and robots.txt must be verified before any API request.

findings: NASA's media guidance says NASA identifiers, insignia, logotypes, and seals are protected; third-party material appearing on NASA sites may retain separate copyright or permission requirements.

NASA's Science Data Portal says records may carry their own license; NASA-led mission data without a restrictive notice are CC0, while other data may originate from third parties and require source-level rights validation.
mandatory_checks: Keep page-derived records to factual metadata and canonical source links unless item-level rights are recorded.
For data records, preserve the explicit item license; apply CC0 only when the record is NASA-led mission data and no restrictive notice is present.
Do not reuse images, video, audio, insignia, logotypes, or identifiable-person media without item-level rights and privacy/publicity review.
Do not imply NASA endorsement or use NASA identifiers as Everything Hub branding.
reviews.api_access: No general NASA page or media API access approval is inferred by this source-level review; images-api.nasa.gov remains separately governed by the catalog-source-terms registry.

findings: USGS-authored or produced information is generally public domain and USGS requests source acknowledgement.
Non-USGS photographs, images, graphics, and other third-party material appearing on USGS pages may be copyrighted and require permission from the rights holder.
mandatory_checks: Classify each record as USGS-authored/produced, third-party, or unknown before any reuse.
Preserve USGS attribution for USGS material.
Do not reuse third-party images or graphics without item-level permission or license evidence.
Do not infer commercial eligibility or republication clearance from the host-level review.
reviews.api_access: No API access approval is inferred by this page-level review; any API use requires a separate allowlist entry, robots check, and rate-limit review.

findings: The Library of Congress provides public JSON/YAML APIs for structured item, collection, image, and metadata discovery without an API key.
LOC enforces rate limits and limits deep paging; individual items and media can have different rights or third-party restrictions, so API accessibility does not establish reuse rights.
mandatory_checks: Keep page-derived records to descriptive metadata and canonical source links unless the individual item's rights statement is reviewed.
Respect current LOC rate limits, response headers, and the documented deep-paging limit; use bounded pagination and facets.
Do not fetch OCR full text, image-service derivatives, or streaming media under this source-level review.
Preserve item-level rights statements and attribution; unknown rights remain metadata-only and non-commercial.
reviews.api_access: The public JSON/YAML API is documented and does not require an API key, but this review does not authorize requests; a separate catalog-source-terms allowlist, robots check, bounded pagination, and rate-limit controls are required.

findings: SBA states that government information on SBA.gov is public domain and may be copied with appropriate acknowledgement.

SBA warns that documents, illustrations, photographs, and other materials contributed or licensed by private parties may remain protected by copyright; privacy and third-party site policies also apply.
mandatory_checks: Classify each record as SBA/U.S. Government-authored, third-party contributed/licensed, or unknown.
Preserve SBA acknowledgement for government information.
Do not reuse third-party documents, images, or media without item-level rights evidence.
Exclude personal information from forms, account portals, or other non-public interactions; do not imply SBA endorsement.
reviews.api_access: No API access approval is inferred by this page-level review; separate API allowlisting and robots/rate-limit checks are required before requests.

next_gate: Locate and verify the current City of Las Vegas portal Terms of Use and robots.txt before any API harvesting. Keep City portal candidates metadata-only until dataset-level terms, provenance, attribution, privacy, and reuse basis are verified. Keep all candidates preview-only until record-level review is complete.
